name: structure-prediction-alphafold
description: Predict protein structure using AlphaFold2 or template-based homology modeling. AlphaFold2 uses the MSA and template information through an Evoformer network (48 blocks of MSA and pair representation updates) and Structure Module (8 recycling iterations) to predict 3D coordinates. For proteins with templates above 30% identity, classical homology modeling with MODELLER remains effective and faster. Evaluate predictions using pLDDT (per-residue confidence) and PAE (predicted aligned error for domain arrangement).
